Shailendra Kumar Appointed Interim Chief Secretary in Jammu and Kashmir

Shailendra Kumar has been appointed as the interim Chief Secretary of Jammu and Kashmir. He will hold the position until Sajjan Singh Yadav joins. This appointment is part of a broader reshuffling of the senior bureaucracy in the region, overseen by the Lieutenant Governor (L-G).
